decisions.reason: As a 2019 flagship range that fits the firm's strategic emphasis on comfort, climate and innovation, it still has high option value and is worth keeping unless clearer evidence of weak demand appears.

Its electrostatic-dissipative function serves a distinct workplace niche, and for an R&D-active footwear specialist the cost of keeping this option open is likely moderate relative to its potential segment value.

Because it appears to be a more standard safety shoe series without the strategic prominence of A or the clearer niche of B, management would be more likely by 2022 to redeploy resources from it to stronger lines and new development.
